name: open-knowledge
title: inkeep/open-knowledge
description: A markdown editor and knowledge base for LLM wikis, specs and notes — wired to your agent.
greeting:
OpenKnowledge — a markdown knowledge base for LLM wikis, specs and notes.

The `ok` CLI (0.86.16, pinned) is installed and on your PATH (node is seeded
in this box). Store workflows auto-INSTALL but never auto-configure, so set it
up yourself:

  1. cd /workspace && ok init     scaffold the knowledge base + wire up claude
  2. In the webui, open this project's ⚙ → Ports, add port 8080 as a Web page
     (label it OpenKnowledge), and copy the address shown under it.
  3. OK_ALLOW_EXTERNAL=1 ok start -p 8080 --no-open-browser \
        --idle-shutdown off --external-url <that address>
     then open the OpenKnowledge tab. The editor only answers at that exact
     address, so pass it verbatim. OK_ALLOW_EXTERNAL=1 lets it accept the
     webui's proxied requests; the webui login is what guards the tab.
  4. claude                        the agent (complete /login first — the box
                                   boots credential-less)
